d:
A playful fish-amphibian species with a rounded head and a wide, smiling mouth. Large, blinking sea-foam green eyes. A small, plump build with three webbed fingers on each hand. Wears no clothes, showing off a pale silver belly and a dark teal back. Features a long, flexible fish tail with a translucent fin and small, pointed fins on the sides of the head.
BODY COLOR: deep teal
